name: Mattress cleaning
summary: How expats book mattress cleaning in Singapore — dust-mite extraction, urine odour treatments, and drying time in humid bedrooms.
body:
Mattress cleaning deep-extracts sweat, dust mites, and spills that surface vacuuming misses. Humid bedrooms need honest drying plans — damp foam becomes a smell factory overnight.

## Typical jobs
- Hot-water extraction for foam / spring mattresses
- Dust-mite and allergen-focused cleans
- Urine / spill odour treatments
- Mattress protector advice after cleaning
- Sofa / soft-toy add-ons

Strip bedding and clear bedside clutter before the crew arrives.

## How to choose
Prefer cleaners who state drying windows and use HEPA extraction. Ask whether both sides are cleaned when the mattress is flippable. Avoid same-hour “fully dry” promises in monsoon weather.

## Practical tip
Book morning slots and run the AC afterward. Sleeping on a half-damp mattress undoes the appointment.
